messages:
Anna CSM: Quick heads-up — Beaconly (enterprise marketing) just announced three new product squads and we9re seeing an unusual embeddings ramp in EU this morning. Could be an expansion signal. Can ops triage? :eyes:
Mike Solutions: What are the raw QPS numbers and index sizes? Is this coming from a single team or multiple teams?
Anna CSM: Aggregate across their org. 24h baseline ~90 QPS -> last 3h avg ~540 QPS; recent peak ~1.1k QPS in eu-central-1. Vector dim 1536, index disk ~38GB. They granted us read-only dashboard: https://beaconly.example/ro-dash
Raj Client Eng: Which embedding model variant are they on? Any quantization applied? Latency/SLO impact?
Anna CSM: Using `mistral-embed-1536` with int8 quantization. Typical p50 ~160ms -> p50 ~390ms during peak. No hard SLO fail yet but increased throttles and a handful of 5xxs around 08:20 CET.
Mike Solutions: Two paths: (A) temporarily route Beaconly traffic to a small dedicated pool for 48-72h; (B) add burst capacity in eu-central. @eng-bot can you run a quick capacity check?
eng-bot: /capacity-check --region eu-central-1 --window 72h
eng-bot: result: spare capacity: 0.6 nodes. Suggest requesting +2 nodes or enable cross-region fallback to eu-west-1.
Sophie AE: Important context: Beaconly renewal in ~5 weeks. If this is org expansion, we should surface a short dedicated pilot + TCO to procurement. Also flag enablement for their infra team.
Anna CSM: They specifically called out jitter between 07:45-09:15 CET. Would like a short post-mortem and an enablement session on batching and prefix caching.
Raj Client Eng: I'll assemble a short runbook + one-pager for their engineers. Immediate config suggestions to try now:
```
routing: {
  policy: region-priority,
  fallback: dedicated-eu-temp,
  batching: { max_tokens: 256, max_batch: 48 },
  kv_cache: { enabled: true, ttl_seconds: 600 }
}
```
Mike Solutions: I'll model costs for (2-node burst for 72h) vs (2-week dedicated pilot). Will include expected token/embedding unit math and delta to monthly spend. Tag me on the PR.
Anna CSM: Action items: Anna 9 follow up with Beaconly and schedule a 45-min enablement workshop; Raj 9 create the runbook + paste into their workspace; Mike 9 cost / pilot proposal; Sophie 9 run renewal outreach and include procurement contact. I'll loop in finance if we recommend a paid pilot. :thumbsup:
Sophie AE: Booking: I'll propose a slot tomorrow 09:30 CET and invite renewals lead + their procurement.
Anna CSM: Thanks all. I'll update this thread once the workshop is scheduled and when eng-infra approves burst nodes. Closing when workshop invite is out. :calendar:
